d:
Union Home Minister Amit Shah has announced that the BJP will implement the Uniform Civil Code (UCC) in Uttar Pradesh if the party returns to power in the 2027 Assembly elections. Speaking at a BJP meeting in Lucknow, Shah also targeted Samajwadi Party chief Akhilesh Yadav and challenged him over the party's political future. Akhilesh Yadav and Rajya Sabha MP Kapil Sibal have responded to Shah's remarks. Here's what happened.
